correctness.rationale: A fresh exact derivative-moment solve on 1,t,t^2,t^3 gives the increment transfers on (r,1,r) and (1,r,1). The resulting characteristic traces and determinants agree for the two orders of the products and under r↔1/r. For w=5z, all three real monic quadratic Schur expressions have strictly positive numerators and a positive denominator for every r>0; the limiting characteristic polynomial is z(z+1/5). At fixed ratio, the product powers decay geometrically even if a Jordan block occurs; the intervening one-step transfer is fixed and finite, so the increments are absolutely summable. Neither a ratio-uniform norm bound nor stability at nonzero test-equation eigenvalues follows. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/reproduction/1.py (SymPy); passed the exact identities, reciprocity and limit checks.
